claim_boundary: The active system is the current task-chat model executing the repository architecture and procedures, but no architecture, model choice, CI/reference result, bounded learning campaign, scheduler repair, Candidate promotion, internal regression decision, self-produced artifact, or unsigned/unverified independence assertion counts as verified AGI.
